title: Scientific Validation Record
description: Domain independent record of a validation performed on a scientific output. See SCIENTIFIC_AGENT_POLICY.md sections 1.7 and 1.20.

id.description: Unique identifier for this validation record.

target.description: Reference to the output, claim, or artifact being validated.

type.description: Validation layer applied. See SCIENTIFIC_AGENT_POLICY.md section 1.7.

method.description: Description of how the validation was performed.

executed_by.description: Agent or human that executed the validation.

schema_reference.description: Reference to a schema used, when type is schema.

details.description: Free text details of the validation outcome.

reproducibility.description: Information supporting reproduction of this validation.
